description: F-86K Sabre (radome nose) on a stone plinth in Plaza El Avión, painted silver with '4341' on the tail and an 'El Esequibo es nuestro' slogan; 4341 may be a painted rather than original number. Photographed 20 September 2023 and 26 April 2025 (Wikimedia Commons).
museum_name: Plaza El Avión F-86K Sabre Monument, Barcelona
